name: Kioku no Umi Kara ~Watermark~
source:
The graduating class of a village school. It consists only of main character and four girls. Soon they fly away from the nest leaving only memories behind. But four years from then the class gets to meet again.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
乡村学校的毕业班。它仅由主角和四个女孩组成。很快它们就飞离巢穴，留下的只是回忆。但四年后，班级再次见面。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2018/12/vn-of-month-june-2000-age-maniax-isumi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
